product.title: Kuromon Market Tour: All inclusive 6~8 Dishes

description.text: In Osaka, this all-inclusive Kuromon Market walk covers six to eight dishes at market stalls with a local guide. The format suits visitors who want a compact tasting window without assembling stall orders independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Osaka, and the itinerary stays on Kuromon Market and its tasting stalls that define this outing rather than a Dotonbori night crawl.

start.description: Meet at the published Kuromon Market meeting point confirmed at booking.

end.description: Return to your Osaka meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
